surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 5 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Masad (The Palm Fibre) is the 111th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 5 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ تَبَّتْ يَدَا أَبِي لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم تبت يدا ابي لهب وتب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined! May he be ruined too

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ما اغنى عنه ماله وما كسب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Neither his wealth nor his gains will help him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he will burn in the Flaming Fire––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and so will his wife, the firewood-carrier

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: with a palm-fibre rope around her neck
